Definition: a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package)
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉrôwr is the Bible's word for a bundle, a parcel. In Genesis 42:35, every man's bundle of money was in his sack, and it appears again in 1 Samuel 9:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉrôwr still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
